facts.fact: The Gambia Press Union, in a statement to the African Commission's 87th session in Banjul, criticised the Cybercrime Bill 2023, the Communications Bill 2025 and the Criminal Offences Act 2025 as threats to media freedom.
The Gambia Press Union said criminal defamation and false publication online had previously been struck down by the Supreme Court, giving no date.

note: Arrests cited (May 2025 protest, March 2026 court incident) are not stated to be for what was said.
